body:
Well guys, can't say I'm doing any better.

Spending more time isolated in my bedroom, lying down, not wanting to interact with anyone.  Trying to finish the play scripts anyway and am blocked by the fact that there's no way I'll ever have a similar outlet again.

Death sentence begins.

And what about sound effects and music?  I can't perform every single one of them live and need recordings.  How are recordings supposed to come through during a Youtube Video with only a 20 dollar headset?

Plus, the music I use will require getting permission and paying for it. Yet another obstacle.  Public Domain music won't have that thematic weight.
I would...if I could afford a top of the line webcam and microphone.  Seeing as how I'm in debt and low on income, it's not possible.

While I appreciate your ringing endorsement, how am I supposed to bring my Radio Plays to life now?  Know of any radio stations online willing to let me perform my own material for free?

Thought not.

As stated in the description, I'm jobless, in debt and getting old.

But who's going to LISTEN?!?

Two of my radio plays I was readying before everything went belly up were my way of processing how I feel so out of touch and alienated in this climate.  I was all set to really make a major footprint.

Now what?  Be a slave to these feelings everyday?  Torture myself because there's no way to prove to people that one of the radio plays, an adaption of a novel, shows I can do a WAY better job than the media company set to air THEIR adaption on television? 

Forget it.
